{{Quote|Get yourselves to the escape pods. I will deal with Grievous here.''"<br />"''But sir, they're commando droids!''"<br />"''That does not matter, Captain. Now go!|Eeth Koth and Lock|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
'''Horn Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that was led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Lock]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. 

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Horn Company attempted to defend the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']] as it was [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|attacked]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]], deep in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The company failed to stop Grievous' assault and most of the unit was forced to flee in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] before their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General was eventually captured by the Confederacy.

==Description==
Horn Company was a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> that served within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] and was made up of four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]], totaling 144 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] along with support personnel.<ref name="Composition" /> The company was led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Lock]].<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> 

The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of Horn Company wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|sand green]] and yellow markings, along with yellow emblems on their [[Breast/Legends|chests]] depicting a set of horns,<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> which identified them as members of the unit. Eeth Koth had black versions of Horn Company's emblem painted on the [[Limb/Legends|forearms]] of his [[Jedi armor]].<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> The company's clone troopers wielded [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] in combat.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==History==
{{Quote|Status report.''"<br />"''There's too many of them!|Eeth Koth and Lock|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
[[File:LockUnderAttack-GI.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Eeth Koth and Horn Company troopers observe Captain Lock and his squad as they attempt to repel invading droid forces.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']], was [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|engaged]] by Separatist forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]],<ref name="FF-2014 21" /> deep in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> Having opened fire on the ''Steadfast'' and initiated boarding maneuvers, Separatist forces boarded the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|star destroyer]],<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> as one of Horn Company's [[Squad/Legends|squads]],<ref name="GI Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/grievous-intrigue-episode-guide|text="Grievous Intrigue" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Lock, fought invading [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] until they were ordered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Eeth Koth to flee in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Lock objected to the order, telling Eeth Koth that he would be facing [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]]. Koth replied that the commando droids did not matter and that Lock and his troopers needed to move to the escape pods immediately.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> 

As the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] general made his way to the ''Steadfast's'' [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and his last troops were forced to confront the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] in one final stand. Having cut through the bridge's [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], Grievous taunted the Jedi before allowing a squad of commando droids to rush into the bridge, [[Death/Legends|killing]] most of the defending members of Horn Company and several [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]]. Eeth Koth managed to defeat the attacking commando droids, with assistance from a surviving member of Horn Company, but both were eventually overpowered by Grievous and his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], who had entered the room and took Koth hostage following a brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horn Company first appeared, albeit unnamed, in "[[Grievous Intrigue]],"<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> the ninth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series, which aired on [[January 1]], [[2010]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue BTS">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode209.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> The company was later identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'', a [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]]<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> and published on [[August 30]], 2010.<ref name="New Battlefronts BTS">{{DK|subdomain=us|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,9780756665326,00.html|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
